canon.ref: characters.json#/skills/101401+101402+101403+101404+101407+101408 + bonus_abilities (Knight of the Dragon, Blessing of the Lake, Crown of the Star)
canon.note: Invisible Air: Barrier of the Wind King (101401, Basic): 100% single-target at L6. Strike Air: Hammer of the Wind King (101402, Skill): main total 150% dealt in 4 hits (10/10/10/70 per notes), adjacent total 75%, heals 7.5% Max HP; Core Resonance can boost the multiplier. Excalibur (101403, Ultimate): consumes 360 Energy; AoE 280% + #3 instances of 110% on random enemies; after the Ultimate the next Basic ATK becomes Release, the Golden Scepter. Release, the Golden Scepter (101408, Enhanced Basic): all-enemy hit, 2 hits of 50/50 (notes), gains 2 Core Resonance. Dragon Reactor Core (101404, Talent): +DMG when any ally uses Ultimate, Core Resonance points, Energy per point consumed. Technique (101407): ATK% for 2 turns + Core Resonance. Crown of the Star (Trace): Skill use grants CRIT DMG +50% for 2 turns. Blessing of the Lake (Trace): up to 120 overflow Energy, 60% Energy at battle start.

fixtures.env: Saber E0 solo vs 3 Wind-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Excalibur (101403) is Saber's Ultimate action (1 cast in the fixture; Ultimate costs 360 Energy).
Strike Air (101402) is her Skill action (4 casts in the fixture).

Two Basic ATK actions in the fixture: 1 Invisible Air (101401) before the Ultimate, then 1 Release, the Golden Scepter (101408) — after using her Ultimate the next Basic ATK switches to Release (101403 note).
Strike Air main-target hits: 16 in the fixture (4 casts x 4 hits, canon 10/10/10/70 split).
Strike Air adjacent hits: 8 in the fixture (4 casts x 2 adjacent enemies, one hit each carrying the full 75%).
Excalibur's main AoE hit strikes all 3 enemies once (3 total).
Excalibur's 10 random instances (101403 #3) all land: 10 damage events spread over the 3 enemies.
Release, the Golden Scepter (101408, Enhanced Basic after the Ultimate) deals 2 hits of 50/50 to all 3 enemies: 6 damage events in the fixture, tagged attackType basic (canon: it IS a Basic ATK).
Invisible Air (101401) is cast once and dealt 1 single-target damage event in the fixture.
Basic ATKs regenerate 1 Skill Point each: 1 Invisible Air + 1 Release = 2 SP.
The Skill costs 1 Skill Point per cast (4 casts = 4 SP).
Strike Air L10 (101402) main total is 150% of ATK; the last of the 10/10/10/70 pieces carries 70% -> 1.05.
Strike Air L10 (101402) adjacent total is 75% of ATK.
Excalibur (101403) main AoE multiplier is 280% of ATK.
Excalibur random instance multiplier (101403) is 110% of ATK.
Release, the Golden Scepter totals 150% of ATK over its 2 hits (50/50 per 101408 notes); the last piece carries 75% -> 0.75.
Invisible Air at the engine's default Basic Lv6 (101401) totals 100% of ATK.
Over the fixture Saber gains exactly 265 Energy (ENERGY_GAIN sum; Ultimate consumes its 360 gauge via overflow per Blessing of the Lake).
Trace/talent state (Dragon Reactor Core Core Resonance machinery, 101404) is active as a persistent buff.
Technique (101407) grants ATK% for #2 = 2 turns at battle start.
Crown of the Star: Skill use grants CRIT DMG +50% for 2 turns.
Excalibur damage resolves after the first Strike Air damage in the fixture (360 Energy needs several Skill casts first).
Release, the Golden Scepter (101408) can only follow the Ultimate: Excalibur damage resolves before Release damage.
